statement: Morning outdoor light exposure is commonly recommended in sleep-medicine education to help anchor circadian timing; individual response varies.

sources.title: American Academy of Sleep Medicine — healthy sleep habits (public education)
sources.notes: Public education on consistent schedule and light/dark cues; not a personal prescription.

sources.title: NIH / NHLBI — Your Guide to Healthy Sleep (light and routine themes)
sources.notes: Foundational public guidance; verify local clinician advice for disorders.

applicability: General wellness adults without clinician-diagnosed circadian or retinal disease constraints.
